en.p: For 4 coins placed on a table, the following trial is performed.

box: Choose one of the 4 coins at random and flip it once.

en.p: Initially, 3 coins show heads and 1 coin shows tails. After repeating the trial above 5 times, given that all 4 coins show the same face, what is the probability that all 4 coins show heads? [4 points]
